specs.value: Hang-on (backpack) external filter for freshwater aquariums
Pre-filter sponge, high-performance bio-filter material, fine filter pad
Height adjustable up to 10 mm; rotates 180°

variants.name: Scaper's Flow, earlier listing (item D5790 / DE-SF)

fits.fact: Made for freshwater aquariums of roughly 30–120 L.
The retailer lists it as suitable for planted tanks and shrimp tanks.
The intake has a sponge guard, which the maker says protects juvenile shrimp.
With the outlet fully underwater, the flow stays gentle and loses little CO2, which suits CO2-injected planted tanks.
The intake pipe has two parts, so its length can be matched to the substrate height.
Comes with intake pipes and a lily pipe for both black and clear back walls.

usage.fact: Ships pre-assembled with all filter media already inside.
The whole unit comes apart completely for cleaning.
Daytime use: keep the lily pipe outlet fully submerged so the flow stays gentle and CO2 is kept in the water.
Nighttime use: raise the top clip to make a small surface whirlpool. This clears surface film and adds oxygen.
Set the lily pipe height to the water level and rotate it to aim the flow.
None of the pages checked give a schedule for cleaning the filter or changing the media.

issues.fact: Flow ratings differ between listings: Dennerle's current page says 450 L/h, while older listings (item 5790/DE-SF) say 360 L/h. A shop that quotes 360 L/h may be selling the older version.
The Belgian shop's title says 450 L/h, but its technical data says 360 L/h and its item number is the older D5790, so check which version you are actually getting.
Sellers advertise it as very quiet, but no independent long-term reviews of noise, leaks or durability could be checked.

alternatives.why: Much cheaper (410,000 VND) and in stock at a Vietnamese shop. Choose it if you don't need a lily pipe or the Dennerle design.
Sold in Vietnam for 590,000 VND. It has a built-in waste-separation chamber, so it is cheaper and readily available locally.
A hang-on filter from a mid-range planted-tank brand, listed at 450,000 VND by a Vietnamese shop (marked out of stock when checked).
